name: Westminster Squanners Spring 2023

venue.name: [The Westminster Schools](https://www.westminster.net/)
venue.address: 1424 W Paces Ferry Rd NW, Atlanta, GA 30327

information:
Square-1 is the main event of this competition, and Square-1 finals will be held in a head-to-head format.

Due to recent new construction (including the building where this competition will be held), **Google Maps may not be able to help you navigate once you enter the Westminster campus**. Please see the Venue/Parking tab for more info about how to park and locate the venue for this competition.

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).
